d.ko: City Transport Simulator 2026 combines a detailed bus simulator and tram simulator in one game. Drive realistic buses and trams, create routes and timetables, manage your fleet, and build your own public transport network in a dynamic European-inspired city.
d.en: City Transport Simulator 2026 combines a detailed bus simulator and tram simulator in one game. Drive realistic buses and trams, create routes and timetables, manage your fleet, and build your own public transport network in a dynamic European-inspired city.
d.zh: 进入城市公共交通的新一代体验——City Transport Simulator 2026! 体验迄今为止最沉浸的公交与有轨电车模拟，城市会根据你的每一个决策动态变化。
